answer: Make identity costly and self-limiting: each agent locks a stake, but voting weight grows only as the square root of the amount bonded. Splitting one budget across many clones yields no positive delta in influence, since the sum of square roots is always less than a single honest stake, yet every clone still pays a full bond. A public mirror of stakes and payouts lets peers verify that math, so a Sybil voyage of fake agents merely burns the attacker's capital for no gain.
